patronOf.en-US: Abbot of Lérins, bishop of Riez
patronOf.pt-BR: Abade de Lérins, bispo de Riez

prayerExcerpt.en-US: "Masters, do to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Senhores, fazei a vossos servos o que é justo e equitativo, sabendo que também vós tendes um Senhor no céu."

meta.face: A Gallo-Roman of Provence of about sixty, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a warm, sun-touched complexion and a gently PEAR-SHAPED face — NARROW at the temples and BROADENING to a WIDE, SOFT, rounded jaw and full lower cheeks, with a small fold under the chin; a LOW, smooth forehead; a SHORT, broad, BLUNT nose; small, kind brown eyes, a little creased at the corners; LOW, heavy, straight dark-grey brows; a wide, gentle mouth in a quiet, fatherly smile; short, thick grey hair in a monk's crown; the gaze warm and fatherly, toward us. Not his abbot honoratus (domed forehead, small lower face), the square-oval, laughing willibrord, the high-browed, jowled luigi_maria_palazzolo, the square, short-faced denis, the flat-faced, bearded leonard_noblac or the round, bearded Peter of Alexandria of this batch.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The kindly face follows the book ('the gentleness and kindliness with which he governed', 'regretted as the best of fathers'); Riez's four Roman columns and its early baptistery (French Wikipedia's lead image) are the town he governed.
